title: Dynamic Article Page
description: Create a view that displays an article based on an ID from the URL.
problemStatement:
## Your Mission

Assume you have a `Post` model (like from Chapter 2). Write a view `article_detail` that takes a `post_id` from the URL, retrieves the post from the database, and returns an `HttpResponse` with the post's title and content.

Define a URL pattern like `/article/<int:post_id>/` that maps to this view.

If the post does not exist, return a 404 error using `get_object_or_404`.

> **Hint**: You'll need to import `get_object_or_404` from `django.shortcuts`.
hints: Use `get_object_or_404(Post, id=post_id)` to retrieve the post.

In the view, build the response string: f"

{post.title}

{post.content}

".
Don't forget to import your Post model.
expectedOutput: When you visit `/article/1/`, you see the title and content of the post with id=1. If id doesn't exist, you see a 404 page.
solutionCode:
# blog/views.py (assuming app name blog) from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404, render from django.http import HttpResponse from .models import Post def article_detail(request, post_id): post = get_object_or_404(Post, id=post_id) return HttpResponse(f"

{post.title}

{post.content}

") # blog/urls.py from django.urls import path from . import views urlpatterns = [ path('article//', views.article_detail, name='article_detail'), ] # project/urls.py – include blog.urls at appropriate path, e.g., path('blog/', include('blog.urls'))
